brief:
Thuraya al-Nasan, sister of slain Omar al-Nasan, called on mourners to wrap her brother's body in both the Palestinian and Egyptian flags, fulfilling a wish he had expressed before his death, Shehab Wire reported. Al-Nasan was killed by Israeli occupation forces in the village of al-Mughayyir, located northeast of Ramallah.

The dual-flag request honors a final testament that al-Nasan had made prior to his killing. His sister's statement to those gathering for funeral proceedings underscored the significance of carrying out the instructions he had left behind regarding the manner in which his remains would be prepared for burial.
